text:
miranda: Quick sync — small ask: can owners confirm the final canary slice sizing and rollback owners for the API v2 cutover? We need a concise list by EOD so we can lock infra slots.

sam: I own the SDK surface. I can do header/backcompat checks and a client-side feature flag, but need to know which runtime headers are considered stable vs deprecated.

natalie: Infra will reserve slot-3 for the canary (10% traffic, 3 replicas). We can drop to slot-2 (5%) if latency spikes. Will that work for SDK canaries?

own: routing + proxy here. We need the auth-proxy passthrough change deployed before canary starts — I can ship the patch but need an ETA from infra for slot readiness. @natalie

sam: ok, plan from SDK side: add `X-Client-Compat: v1` fallback header and a feature flag `enable_v2_route` default false. Will open PR with tests. Example smoke command I’ll use:
```bash
curl -H "X-Client-Compat: v1" \\  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \\  https://api.redwood.dev/v2/generate -d '{"prompt":"test"}'
```

kavya: I’ve got a minimal prompt set for regression (5 seeds + edgecases). Uploading to the test-buckets now — will paste link in a bit. These are the golden vectors we use to detect hallucination regressions.

carla: PM note — we will send the deprecation announcement to affected customers on Feb 3. The message needs: migration docs link, SDK upgrade guide, and opt-out instructions. @sam pls confirm SDK guide will be ready by Feb 1.

sam: yes, will aim for Feb 1. Will include a short migration snippet and note about the `enable_v2_route` flag.

deploy-bot: scheduled canary window: 2025-02-10T20:00:00Z -> 2025-02-10T23:00:00Z (slot-3). Staging smoke run scheduled: 2025-02-09T04:00:00Z.

natalie: routing note — we need to add a readiness probe to the v2 runtime so LB can remove instances immediately on failure. Owen can you add probe doc to your PR?

own: will do that in the auth-proxy PR. ETA is tomorrow AM (2025-01-28).

miranda: final ask for lock: explicit rollback owners and one-line responsibilities so oncall knows who to page if we hit errors during canary. I propose: infra: natalie (slot, autoscale), SDK: sam (client fallbacks + guide), routing/proxy: owen (roll routing rules + proxy passthrough), PM/customer comms: carla.

carla: ack. I’ll draft the short owner card and share with oncall channel.

sam: opened PR #4621 with initial flag + header tests, assigning to @kavya for test vectors.

kavya: reviewing now. Quick note — one of our golden prompts fails current v2 model on length truncation, will mark as flaky in the suite and add an issue.

deploy-bot: staging smoke results: 4/5 checks passed (latency P95 within SLO), one regression flagged (tokenization edge case). See: https://ci.redwood.dev/builds/7802

miranda: perfect, thanks everyone. Action items: natalie confirm slot migration readiness by EOD; owen land proxy passthrough + readiness probe; sam finalize SDK guide by Feb 1; carla draft customer email by Feb 3. I’ll consolidate owners into the cutover runbook after those are done. :thumbsup:

sam: noted, will ping here with PR link when docs are up.

natalie: slot readiness ✅ (reserved, tests queued).

ow: proxy patch merged, readiness probe added, smoke re-run scheduled.

miranda: closing thread — will reopen if anything blocks. Thanks!
